items.title: Complete camera movement and visibility behavior
items.note: Native focus, movement, view presets and desktop navigation are integrated. World view now uses the original wrapped-map projection, adaptive disc mesh, globe lighting, terrain tiles, star field/parallax and flat markers/icons. Native checks cover 18,532 complete mesh triangles, projection/picking, stars, active dragging and opening marker palette; portable mesh fixtures and real browser entry/return, GPU pixels, inputs and resize pass. Ground bearing is preserved. Full settings/key ownership, native frame scheduling, minimap mapping, transition/release inertia, complete marker/effect ownership, cache UV/fog and all visibility remain open; the keyboard/active-drag adapter is partial. Native projected building footprints, AL tribe colors/alpha, shared visible-cell icon eligibility, owner-only hut counts and garrison symbols are now integrated. Comparisons cover 3,072 cell projections, 4,096 complete footprint calls and 384 icon controllers (480/600/768px high); browser checks cover actual colored quads/pixels, relocation/destruction, tower occupants and anchor fog. Tall viewports avoid native signed icon-scale overflow. Full concealment/plan/vehicle ownership, presentation counter, marker raster/queues and overview effects remain open.

items.title: Whole-frame visibility, ordering and raster fidelity
items.note: Non-drawing texture-mode-0 faces are omitted. Native texture initialization/state selection is CPU-checked; ordinary model/cloud/terrain/water materials now filter encoded palette colors bilinearly without mipmaps or anisotropy. 80 GPU calibration samples and unchanged unit point sampling are checked. Full graphics settings, per-batch sampler ownership, texture formats/UV padding, clipping, painter order, native picking and matched original frames remain open. The native globe mesh/projection/shades and star submissions are compared and integrated, with original HFX building/discovery icons and portable native fixtures. Full globe marker rasterization/queues, overview effects and texture-cache UV/fog remain open. Native projected building footprints, AL tribe colors/alpha, shared visible-cell icon eligibility, owner-only hut counts and garrison symbols are now integrated. Comparisons cover 3,072 cell projections, 4,096 complete footprint calls and 384 icon controllers (480/600/768px high); browser checks cover actual colored quads/pixels, relocation/destruction, tower occupants and anchor fog. Tall viewports avoid native signed icon-scale overflow. Full concealment/plan/vehicle ownership, presentation counter, marker raster/queues and overview effects remain open.
